title: Reproduce early-to-late barcode forecast and predictor sensitivity
question: Does cross-culture early barcode information improve a held-out later-distribution forecast beyond the target's own early counts, and does that increment survive separate predictor and outcome perturbations?
deliverables: Explicit reconstruction record and source audit
Target-deletion bounds and synthetic predictor-contamination proof
Reproducible aggregate result manifest and research report
quality_checks: Authenticate workbook and canonical count and barcode contents
Keep held-out late observations out of all parameter tuning
Retain all four cultures and all negative results
Recompute previously reported values without adjusting the design to match them
Run schema validation, Python tests and JavaScript tests
non_goals: Claiming a new resistance mechanism or historical priority
Claiming recovered original commits or a fresh blinded preregistration
Republishing source tables, barcodes, raw reads or patient data
